scope: Diagnosis only. Normal localhost:8781 project was read, not moved, reset or reloaded. No dist application changes were made.
reproduction: Isolated built-in decimal-keypad-3 copy on localhost:8783, 67 boards and 146 wires. The original onPointerMove handler moved one selected keypad board across 36 snapped positions. Four frames were warmup; 32 frame gaps were measured. Electrical simulation remained running. No user layout was modified.
cause: The board-drag branch synchronously calls renderSelection for each pointer event, including repeated events that remain in the same snapped grid cell.
renderSelection calls renderNodes, which visits all boards and their port controls, not only the moved board.
Each actual position change invalidates the network and wireDrawing cache. renderWires replaces the complete SVG wire DOM, including unchanged paths and hit targets.
These global redraws contribute substantial JavaScript and subsequent browser paint work; this is distinct from moving the camera transform.
The last reopening task did not change the code: app.js and app-explorer.js still have SHA256 C77B6585F30F5255DA0CC2AA1CBF9AF31828725F409979220A5725B3482EC8A8.
recommendedRepair: Coalesce drag input to the latest position once per animation frame; flush the final position on pointerup and cancel pending callbacks on cancellation, undo or project changes.
Skip redraw when snapping or collision checking leaves geometry unchanged, while preserving occupied-space feedback.

Reconcile wire SVG elements and hit targets by actual geometry and appearance changes instead of replacing all children. Recompute required crossings and contacts without leaving stale electrical connectivity.
Retain simulation, collision rules, stacked-display contacts, group dragging, grid snapping, history, endpoints, bends and existing visual effects.
caveats: These are short synthetic-handler samples, not a physical mouse latency test or a shipped improvement. Timings are nested and must not be summed. The built-in copy differs from the user's edited project. One event/frame lowers redundant work but remains slow, so coalescing alone is insufficient.
status: Cause reproduced and repair identified; application fix not implemented in this diagnosis.
